title: Speed limit assist and fan speed controls
summary: This topic combines driver-assistance speed-limit behavior with climate fan-speed adjustments, with many fragments describing requests or how-to discussions rather than clear satisfaction judgments.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle's speed or appreciate available fan-speed and vent-control adjustability.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the lack or weak behavior of automatic speed-limit-based speed adjustment in cruise or assist functions.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention requests, settings questions, warnings, or service guidance about speed limits and fan speed without a clear positive or negative judgment.

limitations: The topic mixes at least two distinct subjects: speed or speed-limit assistance and climate fan-speed control.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
Some fragments are procedural or diagnostic statements rather than direct product evaluations.
